comment: Measured-then-frozen moves-shared-spec capture pins (M2 task 7, 2026-07-14). M4 task 1 (iter 64): the vfx post lists carry FULL drawVfx configs (call-time canon; FORMAT.md 'vfx posts') — captures re-recorded under the same STREAM-MATCH + byte-stability guards; record counts unchanged by construction.
